dialogues.speaker: Servan
dialogues.text: Huh? What do you mean by "another one"?

dialogues.speaker: Servan
dialogues.text: I have something new here that you've definitely never seen before!

dialogues.speaker: Servan
dialogues.text: Look at this! It can be squeezed into various shapes and can stick to the wall. It's slime paste!

dialogues.speaker: Servan
dialogues.text: And this one is called "Up, Up, and Away"! Just rub it between your hands and it will rise up into the air!

dialogues.speaker: Servan
dialogues.text: How do you like it? Fun, isn't it? Buy it for yourself or bring it back home to your kids, it's all good!
